_note: 图片池:Roblox 官方 thumbnails API 返回的 5 张游戏页宣传缩略图 + 11 张官方活动(virtual-events)配图 + 官方游戏图标(2026-10-08 取)。全部是开发者上传到 Roblox 的宣传图,不是我们的实机截图,alt 以 Promotional art / Official event art 开头如实说明。NEW MEMECOINS 活动配图只有一个问号,未入池。URL 前缀 180DAY- 表示 Roblox CDN 哈希有效期,官方重传或到期后会变,上线后每 60 天用 source / source_events 重取一次并替换。接口最大 768x432(解码后个别图实际为 767x432),达不到 1200 宽的 Discover 大图门槛。2026-10-08 写入前逐个 curl 验 200(33 个 URL,状态记录在 raw/image-check.txt)。图标(512x512 方图)只在 author 页正文内使用,不做封面与卡图。活动配图含文字,alt 不照抄其中的 coming-soon 字样。

alt.en: Promotional art: a trading card for a stock called OBBY, Obby Dynamics, priced at 154.87 with a candlestick chart, a green BUY button, a red SELL button, a buying power figure, a portfolio value and the label MARKET OPEN

Promotional art of the trading terminal: a candlestick chart for a stock called OBBY, a live Trades panel with a Whales filter, a Long and Short toggle above a Buy OBBY button, and an open long position with a red Close button
Promotional art: a candlestick chart collapsing toward minus 60 percent beside a large red -48.7% TODAY, with a big green BUY button and a small red SELL button
Promotional art: a green arrow curves from a glowing $100 up to $1,284,593 above a rising candlestick chart, with a green BUY button in the corner

Promotional art: a white rising-chart logo over a dark grid of trading panels showing a portfolio value, top movers, a market sentiment gauge reading Bullish, buy and sell buttons, stacks of cash and coins
Official event art for the Hedge Funds update: four strategy cards named Momentum, Quant, Income and Venture, each listing three tiers, above the words Run a hedge fund
Official event art for the scripting update: a script editor showing a short MACD indicator script beside six counters, including 48 functions and 10 price sources, above the words Scripting overhaul
Official event art for the Challenges update: a challenge run chart climbing from a 5K start to a 5M target beside a ladder of four tiers named Bootstrap, Size Up, The Floor and Whale

Official event art for the New Tools update: a chart with a trailing stop and fib retracement levels beside a list of eight new tools, from Trailing Stop and Fib Retracement to Parallel Channel and Text Note
Official event art for the news overhaul: a live feed called The Wire with an earnings headline for Obby Corp, consensus and actual figures, and shorter macro, whale and rumour headlines below
Official event art for the Real Estate update: a pixel map shaped like the United States with five labelled properties and their daily rent, above the words Empire Map
Official event art for the Seasons update: a weekly leaderboard ranked by season return with tier labels, beside a list of eight new features including Weekly Reset, Ranked on Return and Six Tiers
Official event art for the Bonds update: three cards for Government Bonds rated AAA, Corporate Bonds rated BBB and High-Yield Bonds rated BB, above the words Introducing bonds
Official event art for the Commodities Exchange update: three cards for Energy with oil, Metals with gold and Agriculture with wheat, above the words Introducing commodities

Official event art for the interface overhaul: the words The terminal, reimagined above a wide screenshot of the trading terminal with a market list, a candlestick chart, a live trades column and an order panel

Official event art for Custom Offices: a dark corner office at dusk with floor-to-ceiling windows over a lit city skyline, a desk with a monitor showing a rising chart, an office chair and a bronze bull statue on a plinth marked RSE
Official Roblox Stock Exchange 2 game icon: a rising arrow filled with scenes of a candlestick chart, a computer chip, solar panels, data servers and a city campus
